observation: Fresh main mission writers use new Date().toISOString() for mission, cycle, event, evidence and closure timestamps, but durable mission validation and the public v0.1 contract accept arbitrary non-empty strings. Corrupted time values can therefore enter mission reality even though the writer never emits them.
changes: Reuse the existing canonical ISO UTC millisecond predicate already established in run/changeset storage for all mission-owned timestamps.
Publish date-time format constraints for mission createdAt/updatedAt, cycle closedAt, event/evidence at and closure at.
Do not impose temporal ordering or monotonic-clock policy beyond representation validity.

truth_boundary: This cycle closes timestamp representation parity only. Cross-record temporal ordering, monotonicity, clock provenance and authenticated provenance remain separate boundaries.
